request.state:
L01: The board holds twelve seats.
L02: Nine seats are elected and three are appointed.
L03: An elected seat runs for three years.
L04: An appointed seat runs for one year and may be renewed.
L05: The board meets four times a year.
L06: A meeting may be called at short notice by the chair.
L07: Papers go out five working days before a meeting.
L08: No business is transacted unless five members are present.
L09: A member who joins late counts from the moment they arrive.
L10: A member may send a written view but not a vote.
L11: The chair has a casting vote and no other.
L12: Minutes are agreed at the following meeting.

q1.instructions: Which line gives the number of members needed for a quorum?
